headlines.title: CrowdStrike To Reportedly Buy AI Security Startups For $495M, Launches ‘Kill Switch’ For Rogue Agents
headlines.summary: CrowdStrike is expanding its Falcon platform with AI security testing, agent monitoring and new controls to stop unauthorized activity, alongside integrations with Anthropic, AWS and Lovable.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike acquires observability startup Fiddler AI
headlines.summary: Fiddler's capabilities will be integrated into CrowdStrike's Falcon platform as Falcon Observe, which is expected to become generally available in Q4 FY27.

headlines.title: iShares Expanded Tech-Software (IGV) Sells $36 Million of Palo Alto on Oct. 30
headlines.summary: The fund sold $396.0 million of stock and bought nothing, cutting 105 positions while increasing none.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike and Lovable Secure the Next Generation of AI-Built Applications
headlines.summary: AUSTIN, Texas & STOCKHOLM & BARCELONA, Spain, November 03, 2026--Fal.Con Europe 2026 -- CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) and Lovable today announced a new integration that brings Lovable workspaces into CrowdStrike Falcon® Shield, extending security visibility and posture management to AI-built applications.

headlines.title: EY Builds Its Frontier AI and Cyber Resilience Business on CrowdStrike, Commits to Training Cyber Workforce on the Falcon Platform
headlines.summary: AUSTIN, Texas & BARCELONA, Spain, November 03, 2026--Fal.Con Europe 2026--CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) today announced that EY is building its frontier AI and cyber resilience business on the Falcon platform, across more than 20 EY member firms.

description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the United States and internationally. Its unified platform provides cloud-delivered protection of endpoints, cloud workloads, identity, and data through a software as a service (SaaS) subscription-based model. The company offers corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, threat intelligence, data protection, SaaS security posture management, and AI powered workflow automation, and securing generative AI workload services, as well as security orchestration, automation, and response; and security information and event management, and log management services. It primarily sells subscriptions to its Falcon platform and cloud modules. The company has a strategic alliance with Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation to help enterprises secure artificial intelligence across its lifecycle, from the AI agents and models to the foundational infrastructure that supports the entire AI ecosystem and with Snowflake to bring AI-native security and enterprise data at scale. Additionally, it has a partnership with Fortanix Inc. to combine its Falcon platform with Fortanix Confidential AI to provide an integrated solution for end-to-end AI security. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
